strategies.authority: Owner-approved October 6 allocation replacement: broad core >=30%, individual total <=70%, no fixed single-name cap; source-bound company sizing. Existing tactical loss discipline and experimental status remain unchanged. October 7 owner-requested issuer-isolation repair preserves each failed issuer evidence gate and shared account/strategy limits; no experiment adoption or numerical threshold change. October 8 owner-requested two-session capital deployment escalation adds research/route prioritization and explanations; existing account, eligibility, allocation and risk limits remain authoritative. October 9 owner authorization makes private approved local-ledger records authoritative for conditional manual plans: record age/completeness and cash-estimate metadata no longer block research recommendations; known commitments, actual contradictions, economic and strategy limits remain effective. No broker facts or experimental results are changed. Shared publication-input registry repairs dashboard admission of the same approved local-record input; strategy thresholds and economic logic are unchanged. Current research projections also separate superseded historical account metadata requirements from genuine company and order evidence; immutable assessments remain retained. October 11 owner-requested passing-friction audit repairs research visibility and fund routing; accepted company reviews remain visible before numerical eligibility, funds cannot inherit stock sizing, and numerical thresholds, capital authority and experimental status are unchanged. Final artifact audit also distinguishes a current completed adverse company case from unfinished research; such a case remains zero-share NO_ACTION and cannot become eligible. Final dashboard audit keeps unadopted ETF routes out of closest-eligible routing and applies the same zero-share adverse-case rejection in the final capital adapter, including inconsistent upstream candidates. Final rendered explanation audit separates completed company rejection from unfinished research and labels retained evidence thresholds without implying removed fixed position-size tiers; numbers and eligibility are unchanged. October 12 owner explicitly requested full implementation and deployment of current source-bound company valuation into production. Individually versioned admissions override only their issuer comparator; invalid opted-in evidence stays issuer-local with no eligibility fallback. Current-price packet, decisions and email use the same immutable model. A current source-bound allocation plan and unchanged numerical gates remain required; no experiment adoption, risk-limit change or execution authority follows from model admission. Final company-model artifact verification keeps completed adverse cases visible without displacing unfinished company work or being labelled research-incomplete; no eligibility or quality threshold changes. October 14 owner-requested source-to-production closure fixes independently proved SEC time representations, fiscal-quarter source admission, retained zero/partial company-case visibility and the completed-decision clock. Only implementation/source bindings change; allocation targets, numerical quality and tactical risk thresholds, experimental state and human-only execution are preserved. October 19 owner explicitly approved SPY and QQQM jointly counting toward the existing 30% index-core minimum and baseline; either or both funds may supply this same allocation. Individual stocks remain at a 70% aggregate maximum, no fixed name cap, zero internal reserve, and unchanged tactical losses and human-only execution. This version binds the approved fund membership, ETF routing, combined-core calculation and current output adapters. It does not prescribe a fund split, automatically execute the separately assessed rotation, relax the one-share core-shortfall starter, admit other ETFs, promote an experiment or change its frozen implementation. Final rendered-email verification adds the combined SPY + QQQM 30% index-core policy and current aggregate weight to supporting information. This presentation-only completion preserves all strategy authority, numerical admission and sizing thresholds, risk limits, and execution boundaries. October 19 owner-requested research-method integration adds optional source-bound price conditions, falsifiable views, capital-loss paths and exact-original retrospectives to existing dossiers and outputs. These implementation bindings preserve the combined SPY/QQQM core, all allocation and numerical eligibility rules, original model assumptions, experimental status and human-only execution. Missing optional reasoning adds no capital gate; supplied reasoning must satisfy existing evidence-integrity requirements. October 19 owner requested the dated optional SPY/QQQM pair as prominent BUY/SELL review cards before HOLD, with fixed proposed limits, actual-fill sequence, deadline and skip conditions. The maintained writer binds its optional review contract; it creates no capital order draft, assumed fill, additional send or change to eligibility/risk authority. Final rendered-email verification removes generic zero-BUY/SELL placeholders when a separately labelled optional pair is displayed; it does not create executable capital orders or alter eligibility. The owner subsequently set English as the default language. New optional-pair action cards use English; original evidence and immutable plan history remain retained, with all numerical conditions unchanged. October 19 owner requested a current pre-email rotation reassessment. Source-bound pending/adverse/stale assessments lead with Skip the rotation; positive optional cards still require the unchanged price limits and current validated close. Prospective reassessment cannot loosen prices, quantities or deadline. No extra send, experiment promotion or execution authority is introduced. October 19 owner-requested full-universe market backup binds retained unadjusted history and a validated Nasdaq new-session extension. Latest completed-close freshness and provenance replace vendor-specific lag; all numerical investment/rotation limits, eligibility, experimental adoption and execution authority remain unchanged. October 20 owner-requested concurrent trade-recording repair separates short account transactions from public research and binds publication to the account context used in computation. These implementation bindings preserve all strategy, numerical eligibility, risk, experiment and human-only execution rules; no new entry method, extra email or trade authority is introduced. October 20 owner-requested AMZN completion verifies the exact reported gross-PPE alias and official investor RSS source, including bounded issuer-relative article links. This is a source-format/coverage correction; CFO-minus-gross-PPE accounting, numerical quality and price thresholds, capital/allocation/tactical limits, experimental state and human-only execution are unchanged. New filings/news still require separate source-bound analytical review. October 21 owner-approved assessment cadence separates two mandatory daily briefs from changed action or source-bound research-priority alerts, effective October 22. Bounded market-hours short checks supplement the two full reviews. These implementation bindings preserve every valuation, allocation, entry, tactical risk, experimental and human-only execution rule; delivery purpose does not create investment eligibility. October 22 owner-requested live cadence repair binds source-validated collector journal classification, harmless provider-order normalization and transaction-scoped read-only source validation. All economic model assumptions, numerical entry/quality/risk rules, allocation, experimental status and human-only execution are unchanged. Publication-only completion is distinct from the full research refresh and grants no eligibility. October 22 owner-requested validated intraday observations and portfolio risk supplement short checks. This version binds separately retained regular-session Nasdaq Last Sale observations, admitted EOD comparison history and an optional same-inventory portfolio risk projection. Observations grant no trade or email eligibility; all economic limits, model assumptions, entry gates, experimental status, mandatory briefs, extra-alert and duplicate protection rules remain unchanged.
